## Summary
- Wires cached-input reads, Anthropic cache writes, service-tier selection, and batch execution mode into runtime spend accounting.
- Adds focused regression coverage for the E9 blocker found before writing E9's test-only packet.

## Scope
Runtime spend-accounting fix only. No model-map or cost-profile registry changes.

## Validation
Focused pytest, compileall, proof parse/checksum, and diff whitespace checks.

## NOT_RUN
- Live provider calls.
- E9 test-only packet.
- F verification packet.

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- Provider-side service_tier echo behavior remains best-effort; pricing uses requested/default tier when no observed tier is available.
